card.name: Inside long medical words, early pieces
card.fires_on: Responds to a short early piece inside a long, rare medical or biological word, such as the 'em' of emollients or emulsions and the 'In' of Intratrusor. Also fires on 'the' before a rare anatomical term.

modes.label: Start of emollient/emulsion
modes.description: The 'em' piece that begins emollients or emulsions after 'Topical' or 'destabilizers of'.

modes.label: Start of other rare terms
modes.description: A short opening piece of an uncommon term, such as the 'In' of Intradetrusor or the 'id' ending peracarid.
